#### Spam / Quality signals

1. [ ] This plugin is at least 30 days old.

2. [ ] The author of the plugin has had a github account for at least one year.

3. [ ] Generative AI was used to edit code or assets.

4. [ ] This plugin has had commits in the last 14 days.

5. [ ] This plugin supports the latest stable Jellyfin release.
